title: How to use zoxide
partialText: Learn how to install and set up zoxide, then jump between frequently used directories with z, interactive selection, and frecency ranking.

title: How to send email with Cloudflare Email Service
partialText: Send transactional email from a Cloudflare Worker using the native Email Service binding, with domain setup, local testing, and error handling.

title: A deep dive into Nurb
partialText: Nurb turns a coding agent into a CAD partner. Learn how Python parts, OCCT solids, live checks, measurements, and 3MF export fit together.

title: Modern CSS colors: oklch() and color-mix()
partialText: oklch() gives perceptually uniform colors, and color-mix() blends them. Build palettes and tints with modern CSS color functions in all major browsers.

title: Why I use anti-slop skills
partialText: Anti-slop skills catch common AI habits before they reach the final result. Here's how I use them as a separate review pass for writing and code.

title: Herdr vs tmux vs Zellij
partialText: Compare Herdr, tmux, and Zellij for persistent terminal sessions, remote work, layouts, plugins, and running multiple coding agents.

title: Scroll-driven CSS animations
partialText: Animate elements from scroll position with animation-timeline scroll() and view(). No JavaScript needed. Check current browser support before shipping.

title: Swamp tutorial: make AI agent work repeatable
partialText: Learn how Swamp turns one-off AI agent work into typed, repeatable automation with models, workflows, assertions, and versioned data.

title: How to group array items with Object.groupBy()
partialText: Group an array by a property with Object.groupBy() instead of a reduce loop. See a realistic expense example and Map.groupBy() for object keys.

title: A deep dive into Grok Bot
partialText: A detailed Grok Bot guide covering setup, persistent computers, skills, routines, approvals, real use cases, limits, pricing, and alternatives.

title: A practical guide to Herdr plugins
partialText: Install, inspect, configure, run, and build Herdr plugins, with practical commands and the security checks to make before trusting one.

title: CSS Subgrid
partialText: CSS subgrid lets nested grid items align to parent tracks. Build aligned cards and forms, understand spans and gaps, and add a practical fallback.

title: A deep dive into pstack
partialText: pstack is a Cursor plugin for rigorous agent work. The same SKILL.md files also load in Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents.

title: How to use Herdr skills and herdr --skill
partialText: Learn how to install the Herdr agent skill, use herdr --skill, and let coding agents safely inspect, split, run, and wait in panes.

title: JavaScript immutable array methods: toSorted(), toReversed(), toSpliced(), with()
partialText: Need to sort or reverse an array without mutating it? Use toSorted(), toReversed(), toSpliced(), and with() to get a new copy instead.

title: Native CSS Nesting
partialText: Native CSS nesting works without Sass. Learn basic nesting, the ampersand selector, nested media queries, specificity gotchas, and when to drop preprocessors.

title: The View Transitions API
partialText: Create smooth same-document animations with the View Transitions API using startViewTransition, CSS pseudo-elements, and view-transition-name on elements.

title: MutationObserver and ResizeObserver
partialText: Use MutationObserver to watch DOM changes and ResizeObserver to track element size changes, with practical examples and cleanup via disconnect().

title: The Popover API
partialText: Build native browser popovers with the Popover API using HTML attributes, auto and manual modes, CSS backdrop styling, and JavaScript show and hide methods.

title: Find command-line tools from a macOS app
partialText: Fix tools that work in Terminal but disappear from Finder-launched macOS apps by locating binaries and building an explicit child-process PATH.

title: The HTML dialog tag
partialText: Learn the native HTML dialog element for accessible modals: showModal, close, form method dialog, backdrop styling, and why it beats div modals.

title: The CSS :has() selector
partialText: The CSS parent selector styles an element from what is inside it. Forms, cards, previous siblings, quantity queries, and when JavaScript is still better.

title: What I learned reading Claude's system prompts
partialText: I read Anthropic's published Claude system prompts. Most of the product lives in the rules, facts, tools, and safety checks around the model.

title: CSS Container Queries
partialText: CSS container queries style a component by its own width, not the viewport. Learn container-type, named containers, query units, and the traps that break layouts.

title: Add a local LLM without making your app depend on it
partialText: Add optional Ollama-generated summaries to a Swift app while preserving deterministic fallback data, short health checks, failure backoff, caching, and testability.

title: AbortController: how to cancel a fetch request in JavaScript
partialText: Learn how to cancel fetch requests in JavaScript with AbortController, handle AbortError, set timeouts, and abort on unmount or superseded requests.

title: The Intersection Observer API
partialText: An in-depth tutorial on the Intersection Observer API: entries, thresholds, rootMargin, lazy loading, infinite scroll, scrollspy, visibility tracking, and the pitfalls to avoid.

title: Cloudflare AI Gateway: put a proxy in front of your LLM calls
partialText: Learn how Cloudflare AI Gateway sits between your application and AI models, then route and inspect a real request through a Worker.

title: Cloudflare Workers AI: run LLMs without API keys
partialText: Learn what Cloudflare Workers AI is, connect its AI binding to a Worker, and build a small text summarization API step by step.

title: HTTP/2 and HTTP/3: what changed and why it matters
partialText: Learn how HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 changed connections, multiplexing, compression, QUIC, deployment, and the web performance decisions you make today.
